description: Request an email or in-app Notification on a DocType event, or change, disable, enable one (condition and templates checked on a real document, recipients and daily volume shown, needs approval)

name.description: Notification name (3-140 characters). Must be new for create

document_type.description: DocType it watches (create only), e.g. Sales Invoice

method.description: event Method only: the document method, e.g. on_update_after_submit

date_changed.description: Days Before/After: a Date or Datetime field (or creation/modified)

value_changed.description: Value Change: the field to watch

channel.description: Default Email. SMS/Slack only when the site already has them configured

slack_webhook_url.description: Slack only: an existing Slack Webhook URL record

condition.description: One Python expression on doc, nowdate() and frappe.utils, e.g. doc.grand_total > 10000 and doc.docstatus == 1

message.description: Jinja (HTML/Markdown) with doc, alert, comments, nowdate, frappe.utils, _()

receiver_by_document_field.description: owner, a User link, a Data field with options Email; child table field as 'field,child_table'

receiver_by_role.description: Every enabled user with this role

cc.description: Addresses separated by commas or new lines (Jinja allowed)

condition.description: Python expression: this row only when true

recipients.description: Replaces the whole recipient list on update

attach_print.description: Email only: attach the document's print

print_format.description: Existing, enabled Print Format of document_type (default: Standard)

allow_external.description: true only after the user confirmed sending to cc/bcc addresses that are not users of this site

sample_document.description: Document to evaluate the condition and render the preview on; default: the latest you can read

purpose.description: One line, shown on the card and kept as a Jinja comment in the message
